newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen rising after Wall Street gains.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen rising after Wall Street gains.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rise for the second consecutive session after Wall Street's strong gains on Tuesday and helped by lower than expected March inflation data, released on Tuesday.

They said the Dow Jones rise helped by the relatively low 0.8-percent Polish CPI growth figure was likely to positively influence the Warsaw bourse at least on Wednesday, but were not sure about the market's direction later.
Exbud starts continuous trade on Wednesday, joining the 22 stocks already traded in the continuous trade system.
